messages.subject: Mining ESG Executive | Government Relations, Sustainability & Stakeholder Leadership
messages.body:
Dear JRG Partners Team,

Your executive-search work for mining and minerals sustainability and ESG leadership is directly aligned with my background. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, leading government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates where responsible mining, community relations, permitting and regulatory credibility are central to long-term value. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, with broader international mobility.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
